image_description: A close-up macro shot of a single ripe fig fruit. The fig has a pear-like shape with a broad base tapering to a stem at the top. The skin is a mix of deep purple and green hues with small yellow speckles (lenticels). The bottom ostiole (eye) is visible as a small dark opening. The background is a soft, out-of-focus green, suggesting foliage. There is a faint watermark text in the bottom right corner.
